_about: Manual corrections applied by scraper.js on top of the MAI data, keyed by MAI marker id.
{ "city": "X" }    - the pin is in the right place but MAI lists the wrong city.
{ "exclude": true } - the coordinates contradict the address (pin is 12-190 km from the listed city), so the point is left off the map rather than sending someone to the wrong place.
Found in November 2026 by comparing every point with the median position of its city and reverse-geocoding the outliers with OpenStreetMap Nominatim.

Added 2026-11-25 (launch-readiness B-2), each checked with a Nominatim reverse geocode: 15 more excludes where the pin is in a different locality than the address (3.5-190 km away), 13 city fixes where the pin is right and the city was wrong, and 347251 excluded because its name is a coordinate and it has no address.

Added 2026-11-25 (launch-readiness B-3): 346143 is at the entrance to Kibbutz Eilon, 0.6 km from the other אילון point, so its city is אילון (MAI wrote איילון). 344355 is the fuel station by Kibbutz Dvir, which MAI lists under the kibbutz's other name דבירה; its city is דביר so the two points are found together.

Added 2026-11-25 (data-quality audit of the refreshed file), each checked with a Nominatim reverse geocode of the pin: 30 city fixes where the pin is right and MAI lists a neighbouring town or a label that is not a town (דיפו ירושלים, סינרמה, צומת שילת, מ.א. עמק חפר ...), always using a spelling already in the data; and 22 excludes from the 25 same-name-same-address pairs - 15 where the pin is in a different locality or on a different street than the address names, and 7 second entries of one point (pins under 500 m apart, the higher id is left out).

Added 2026-11-25: 346330 and 346351 share one coordinate at the centre of באר שבע with no street ("בכניסה הצפונית", "פארק אופיק"). In a city that size a centre pin can be kilometres from the place, so both are left out.

Added 2026-11-25 after review of the refreshed file: 345747 (address נתב"ג לוד, pin in באר שבע, 76 km away) and 342784 (address רמות ירושלים, pin in north תל אביב, 46 km away) came back when same-name twins stopped being dropped; 345502 and 345653 share one coordinate in מגדל העמק but name two different industrial zones with no street.
Added 2026-11-25: 346434 (רמי לוי, העמל 20) had the city "ים"; Nominatim puts the pin in the industrial area of כפר סבא.

Added 2026-11-26: 25 city entries for markers that MAI publishes with a street but no city (343975-343996, 346749, 346774, 347297). Until now the scraper took their city from the previous locations.json by coordinate, so a lost file or a coordinate nudged by 1 m would have removed them for good; the cities here are the ones that file had.
Added 2026-11-26: 343108 is inside the ביאליק רוגוזין school campus (\"ביאליק רוגוזין, כניסה ראשית\"), which does not say school in words the school rule can see; schools are left off the map.

Added 2026-11-26 ("good to great" audit), 33 city fixes where the pin is right and the city label is wrong. 11 from the data-quality report, each checked there against OpenStreetMap (342668 מודיעין עילית, 346666 סכנין, 346665 כסרא סמיע, 344436 ירושלים, 346222 גבעת חן, 342842 רמת יוחנן, 342845 כפר הנוער הדתי, 347324 עין בוקק, 346155 באר שבע, 344330 חולון, 344132 משמר השבעה). 344902 and 344905 name קריית חיים as their place and sit among its points, so they join that city. 12 from the spatial report, where the pin sits among points of the neighbouring town (346693, 344847, 347124, 345339, 343571, 343676, 346245, 344139, 344699, 344708, 345879, 345956). 8 where one building was listed under two or three cities: מרכז מסחרי תל חנן and דרך בר יהודה 111 are in נשר (343443, 345153, 345364, 346694); מבצע קדש 56 is in בני ברק and דרך העמק 41 in נוף הגליל by a Nominatim reverse geocode of the pin (344033, 345259, 345577); 344549 shares its coordinate with a נתניה point (פולג is a part of נתניה).

Added 2026-11-26: 343449 (תל חנן), 344534 (עמק שרה) and 344555 (פולג) each were the only point of a neighbourhood listed as a city, sitting among points of נשר, באר שבע and נתניה (validator warning 14c). 343053 has the regional council as its city; Nominatim puts the pin in פארק תעשיות משגב תרדיון, so its city is תרדיון (as משגב it had the same name as 343050, 2 km away).

Added 2026-11-26 (spatial audit): 14 excludes where points of one street in one city are over 1.5 km apart and a Nominatim reverse or forward geocode puts the pin in another town or on another street than the address (342619, 343674, 343678, 343793, 344802, 344960, 345162, 345267, 345578, 345581, 345646, 345672, 345809, 346367; 1.9-10 km off). 3 second entries of one point under a wrong city, pins under 30 m apart, the entry that contradicts its pin is left out (343051 = 347269, 344893 = 344892, 346460 = 346186).

Added 2026-11-26 (same address, pins over 1 km apart), each checked with Nominatim: 342645 and 344846 (קניון מלחה) sit on בית"ר street in תלפיות, 3.6 km east of the mall and of its nine other pins; 345126 (ביג צ'ק פוסט) is at דרך בר יהודה 107 in נשר and 345129 at נווה שאנן, 2.0 and 1.3 km from the complex at בר יהודה 111; 345088 (קניון עזריאלי חיפה) is at ויצו 9, כרמליה, 1.2 km from its six other pins; 345922 (אבן עזרא 16, אשדוד) is 834 m from every part of the street in OpenStreetMap, at כיכר התרבות, while its twin 346101 is 57 m from it; 346589 (ויצמן 1, אשדוד) is on ויצמן street in קריית מלאכי, 12 km from אשדוד, the same slip as 346367. Kept: 344011 (הרצל 91, רמלה) is on the house-level geocode; 346743 and 346744 (דרך השלום 20, נשר) are both on the street (9 m and 45 m) and nothing says which is number 20; 347326 (קולומביה, address ביג רגבה, pin and city חוצות המפרץ, 19 km apart) cannot be told.

Added 2026-11-26 (new validator warning 14d: same street in one city, nearest same-street point over 1.5 km away), each checked with Nominatim: 346486 (קואופ שופ, דב גור 27, אשדוד) is 2.25 km from every part of דב גור while 347344 (דב גור 15) is 39 m from it; 345778 (מחסני חשמל, שדרות המייסדים 15, מעלה אדומים) is on שדרות החברה הכלכלית, 2.8 km from the three points at numbers 15-17, which sit together at גבעת המייסדים.

Added 2026-11-26: 3 second entries of one shop (validator check 25: same chain, same address, under 100 m), 63-90 m apart, so further apart than the 50 m the scraper merges by itself; the higher id is left out, as the scraper does: 343429 = 343376 (רמי לוי, דבורה הנביאה 128, תל אביב), 346637 = 343522 (קרביץ, המלאכה 2, רעננה), 344569 = 344434 (רמי לוי, תדהר 1, פרדס חנה).

Added 2026-11-26: 344231 (קרביץ, "מתחפ ביג פוריה") is in טבריה: Nominatim puts the pin on המברג in אזור תעשייה טבריה עלית, where the other shops of the same BIG centre are listed under טבריה. It became the only point of "פוריה" when its second entry 346634 was merged into it (warning 14c).

Added 2026-11-26: 346759 (קרביץ - קניון עופר השרון) is a second entry of 346641 (קרביץ - השרון- קניון עופר), same chain and address (הרצל 60, נתניה), 92 m apart; it showed in check 25 once the place stopped being repeated in the address. The higher id is left out.

Added 2026-11-27 (owner decision): points inside places the public cannot freely enter are left out, like schools. 343333 ("מוקד איסוף - מחנה רמון", שדה בוקר) is an air force base; 344808 (MAI name "משטרת ישראל, מבנה מרכזי", חיים בר לב 1, ירושלים) is inside the national police headquarters; 345833 ("מכינה קדם צבאית", ההדרים 21, כפר יונה) is a pre-army academy.

Added 2026-11-27: 5 second entries of one shop under another city, which the scraper merged by chain and distance until it learned that two cities are never one shop. Each pair checked with Nominatim (reverse geocode of the pin, forward geocode of the places); the entry whose label does not fit its pin is left out. 343950 (אייס, "מרכז ביג, קרית אתא") is 36 m from 344152 (צומת וולקן, חיפה); its pin is at הסולל, רובע מפרץ חיפה, חיפה. 346211 (דור אלון, "גבעת השלושה") is 9 m from 345318 (כביש 40, כניסה למושב נווה ירק); the pin is 841 m from נווה ירק and 4.4 km from גבעת השלושה. 346441 (דלק מנטה, "בית לחם הגלילית") is 2 m from 343849 (כביש 77, מחלף זרזיר); the pin is on road 7626, 114 m from צומת זרזיר and 1.9 km from the village. 347313 (קולומביה, "צומת כח") is 12 m from 347314 ("שבילים, צומת זרזיר"); the pin is 136 m from צומת זרזיר, and צומת כ"ח is in the Upper Galilee, 55 km away. 346634 (קרביץ, "צומת פוריה א.ת", city פוריה) is 1 m from 344231 (טבריה by override); the pin is on המברג, אזור תעשייה טבריה עלית, טבריה.

Removed 2026-11-27: 7 overrides that did nothing, found by the new "overrides without effect" report of scraper.js. Their records are skipped as schools (owner decision, settled), so the city fixes 344824 (עוספייה), 345329 (תל אביב), 345596 and 345597 (אלעד), 346048 (שפרעם), 347289 (אום אל פחם) and the exclude 345588 change nothing. Corrected 2026-11-27: this line first called 345148 and 345913 dead as well, which was wrong. Each city fix is what lets its record merge with its twin in the same city: 345148 (חיפה) is then the same shop as 344152, and 345913 (שפרעם) the same point as 345903; without them a second pin appears under "חוצות" or "אבטליון". Both stay.

Removed 2026-11-27: the exclude 344803 (רמי לוי, "היוצרים 7, כרמיאל", pin in תל אביב). Its record shares one exact coordinate (32.071749, 34.794428) with 343446 (יגאל אלון 108, תל אביב) and 346433 (צומת גילת), three different streets, so the stacked rule drops it anyway (settled: the scraper drops every such group). The scraper's "overrides without effect" report listed it, and a build without the exclude gives the same locations.json.

Added 2026-11-27: 347314 (קולומביה, "שבילים, צומת זרזיר") had the junction as its city, so a search for a town did not find it. Nominatim reverse geocode of the pin: road 7626 in מועצה אזורית עמק יזרעאל, inside no town; forward geocode: זרזיר is 891 m from the pin, רמת ישי 5.4 km. The pin is 46 m from 343849 (דלק מנטה, "כביש 77, מחלף זרזיר"), which MAI lists under רמת ישי although its own label names זרזיר; the nearest town and the junction's name both say זרזיר, a spelling already in the data (344335).
An id that MAI later fixes or removes can simply be deleted from this file.
